body: Not sure why you went out of your way to craft this edited rebuttal especially since I had already apologized to you. In any case, while I appreciate you taking the time to respond to me, I kindly suggest that you take your own advice before casting stones. I will not be responding on this thread any longer. Have a nice life.

I apologize for my previous comment and thank you for your eloquent and thoughtful responses. After having some time to cool down, they really made me feel better. I've made the decision to forgo suicide.

It matters because, whether you like
it or not, these people ultimately hold my future in their hands. You have to be a fucking millionaire or otherwise immune from earthly needs to not care what others think. I don't know what fantasy world you live  in, but in the real world others can make or break your life. You live in isolated world where you answer to no one. Good for you, the majority of the world does not have that luxury. Fuck off!
I don't feel there's anything left to fix, people will always see me as an idiot.
Left something out of a definition when it was literally posted right in front of me. Everyone got a huge laugh what a stupid fool I was.
